notes.subject: mekim i kirap nogut
notes.rationale: המרו i tok bilong mekim kirap (mararim), Strong i tok 'make bitter' — hia mi usim pasin bilong kirap nogut

notes.subject: המרו / מריבה
notes.rationale: המרו i save wantaim nem bilong ples Meriva ( Stat 20:13, olgeta ves 106:32), tok i kamap wankain — Tok Pisin i no inap holim

notes.subject: em i tok nogut
notes.rationale: ויבטא: KJV 'unadvisedly', YLT 'wrongfully', JPS 'rashly' — inap narapela man i spik (em i Mose), o narapela spik 'ol i bin mekem em i spik olsem'

translation: Bilong olsem, ol i mekim ⟨את⟩ ruak bilong en i kirap nogut, na em i tok nogut long lepa bilong en.

tokens.gloss: ol i mekim i kirap nogut
